ic_name: HDMI / DVI TMDS (TI TFP410 PanelBus Digital Transmitter — subset)
signaling_summary: DVI / HDMI T.M.D.S. (Transition-Minimized Differential Signaling) is a current-mode differential serial interface DC-coupled between the TFP410 transmitter and the display receiver. Each of the 4 differential output pairs (TX0/TX1/TX2/TXC) is driven by a current-mode driver whose full-scale current I_FS is set by the external R_TFADJ resistor; the receiver provides 50 Ω termination to its own AV_DD (~ 3.3 V) so the differential swing V_SWING = I_FS × R_T ≈ 400-600 mV single-ended. Differential swing 2 × V_SWING ≈ 800-1200 mV pp. Input side (DATA/IDCK/DE/HSYNC/VSYNC/CTL) supports two voltage modes: HIGH-SWING (3.3 V CMOS) when V_REF = DV_DD, and LOW-SWING (1.1-1.8 V adjustable) when V_REF = 0.55-0.9 V. PLL multiplies the input IDCK pixel clock by 10× internally to generate the serializer bit clock. On-chip 1.8 V regulators + bypass capacitors isolate the PLL from supply noise (enhanced PLL noise immunity).

tmds_data_rate_ranges.raw_pixel_throughput_per_pair_pixels_per: pixel_clock × 1 (3 pixels per IDCK period total across TX0/TX1/TX2)

termination_and_swing_setup.TFADJ_purpose: External pull-up resistor on TFADJ pin (to TV_DD) sets the full-scale current of the TMDS drivers; controls V_SWING. R_TFADJ ≈ 510 Ω targets V_SWING ≈ 400-600 mV (DVI compliant).
termination_and_swing_setup.tmds_OFF_state: When TMDS is disabled (PD=0 or TDIS=1), V_OFF = AV_DD (both TX+ and TX- pulled to AV_DD); differential = 0.

analog_components_per_channel: Current-mode differential driver (programmable full-scale current via TFADJ).
10:1 serializer (parallel-in, serial-out shift register clocked by the 10× PLL bit clock).
T.M.D.S. encoder (8 → 10 bit transition-minimised + DC-balance + control-character generator).
Per-channel running disparity counter (DC-balance state machine).

Receiver-side: 100 Ω differential termination (50 Ω each leg to AV_DD), comparator with threshold near AV_DD - 0.25 V (mid-point of TMDS LO/HI), 1:10 deserializer, 10b → 8b decoder, control-character detector.
shared_analog_blocks: PLL (PLL power supply PV_DD = 3.3 V; ground PGND): multiplies IDCK by 10× to make bit clock; on-chip regulators + bypass caps for noise immunity.
1.8 V regulators (on-chip, for digital core internal rails; bypass capacitors).
Input voltage-mode receivers (3.3 V CMOS in high-swing; comparator-style in low-swing).
Input clock receiver (single-ended CMOS or fully differential — selected by VREF + DSEL combination).
Differential clock crossover-point detector (low-swing mode uses crossover as timing reference).
notes: The TFP410 is a mixed-signal device with a high-speed analog TMDS PHY (~ 1.65 Gbps per pair) on the output side and a 3.3 V (or adjustable 1.1-1.8 V) CMOS digital interface on the input side. The PLL is the dominant analog risk; TI provides on-chip 1.8 V regulators + bypass capacitors specifically to suppress supply-noise-induced PLL jitter (t_ojit ≤ 150 ps). PCB layout for the TMDS pairs follows standard high-speed differential rules (100 Ω diff impedance, ≤ 50 ps intra-pair skew, ≤ 1.2 ns channel-to-channel skew, ESD protection rated ±4 kV HBM on DVI pins). TI SLLA414 application note provides general high-speed differential routing guidance applicable to TMDS layout.
